profile.summary: A nonprofit performing arts school based in South San Francisco. It offers music, dance, drama and improv classes, and runs in-school and after-school arts programs and an Artist-in-Residence Program for Bay Area schools. It also produces musical and theatrical shows.

sources.title: Coastal Currents Conservatory - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Identity looks right (South San Francisco performing arts nonprofit, one-letter name difference, EIN 39-2257001 confirmed on ProPublica and the site, arts services fit the Prop 28 contract), though no source mentions OUSD or Skyline. The summary claims 'after-school arts programs' and 'Bay Area schools', but the cited pages mention only in-school classes and an Artist-in-Residence Program teaching TK-12 'across the Peninsula', so the summary is not fully supported.
